title: Universal Media Decomposer architecture options analysis
body: Reviewed Task.md, upstream technology research, and complete T1-T8 adversarial log. Greenfield repository has no prior ADRs or implementation constraints. Surviving architecture is a single Postgres semantic ledger with versioned/upcastable events, shared Tier-0/Tier-1 reducer, single-writer rebuildable projections, OCFL immutable blobs, stable versioned locators, Hatchet primary with handler-level DB dedup, and Neo4j/RDF as disposable projections only. Key residuals to preserve: pyannote weights license, best-effort Whisper hallucination filtering, sandbox platform profile/caps, splink/DuckDB build benchmark, Hatchet exact pin, FFmpeg CVE watch, split-time reference enumeration, and OCFL local spooling. Preparing durable options report with A lead and B/C/D alternatives, scored tradeoffs, ownership map, interfaces/repository shape, rejected authorities, and requirement coverage.

title: UMD architecture status reconciliation observation
body: The architecture must explicitly address the queued-state gap: ProductionDAGRunner currently submits queued stage events without local stage-state rows, while JobService refresh can regress RUNNING to PENDING before callbacks. Prefer durable queued stage rows or an equivalent explicit asynchronous status contract; never fabricate COMPLETE.

title: PLAN_ONLY amendment: hosted netns and sandbox evidence
body: Reviewed approved DD, Plan K, support-researcher L6, current validation workflow, compose topology, and diagnostics. New evidence must split run 33228084721/job 99035605497 exact Docker daemon bind-mount /proc/4215/ns/net -> /var/run/docker/netns/bfa422ad7204: no such file or directory during compose up, followed by 5 reconcile failures, from run 33228376245/job 99036443345 where startup milestones succeeded but reconcile saw sandbox-runner=restarting and hatchet-migrate/admin=absent. Current workflow unconditionally invokes --profile sandbox and requires sandbox-runner running, although compose marks sandbox-runner optional/profile-gated and its worker command receives no Hatchet token/env beyond the shared API env, making independent restart likely. Current one-shot classification checks only container status via compose ps -a -q, and suppresses reconcile-up output/exit code. Amendment analysis should require observable service state, exit codes, restart count, error, and logs; classify daemon race, mandatory long-lived services, optional sandbox, and one-shot completion separately; preserve mandatory Hatchet/API gates and forbid silent skips.

title: Plan K lineage barrier options grounding
body: Grounding for the live Hatchet dependency-barrier decision: hosted run 33240528692 disproved TriggerWorkflowOptions.parent_id as a dispatch barrier; persisted task parenting uses parent_step_run_id -> parent_task_run_external_id but remains singular/unproven. Existing source uses runner.submit_workflow_runs with one workflow run per stage and latest-direct-dependency parent_id, while STAGE_DEPENDENCIES has multi-parent edges (ENTITY_RESOLUTION, CROSS_SOURCE_ALIGNMENT, SEMANTIC_RECONCILIATION). Canonical evidence selection is job-independent and fail-closed in Postgres, and DurableStageExecutor owns claim-before-side-effect/UNIQUE idempotency/completion. Four user-mandated options will be compared without editing production/tests/contracts/plans/DD. Awaiting fresh researcher and fresh lineage-barrier adversarial artifact before final report.
